versions.changelog:
Initial, streamlined quantum circuit skill supporting Guppy & Selene emulator.

- Major simplification: removes scaffolding, templates, and cloud deployment scripts; focuses only on local quantum circuit authoring and emulation.
- Adds direct documentation for Guppy v1.0, common developer gotchas, migration, and runtime caveats (see SKILL.md and new references).
- Documentation overhaul: concise quickstart, critical notes for parameterization, angles, noise, sweeps, and platform integration.
- Adds over 25 reference docs for rapid learning and advanced circuit development.
- Removes all frontend, deployment, and clinical/scaffolding boilerplate/assets.
- Target audience: researchers and developers writing and running quantum circuits and algorithmic pipelines, especially those using/porting to Guppy v1.0 and Selene.

quantinuumclaw 0.1.1

- Adds detailed documentation (SKILL.md) describing stack components: Quantinuum, Guppy, Selene, Fly.io, and optional frontend.
- Provides clinical and general use-case guides, stack workflow, and quick-start commands.
- Outlines best practices for clinical data, security, deployment, and troubleshooting.
- Includes resource references for setup scripts, API patterns, and use-case mappings.
- Clarifies compliance notes for healthcare deployments.
